sum: VivoPower PLC, together with its subsidiaries, develops and owns powered land and data center infrastructure for AI compute applications in Australia and Norway. It operates through Data Center, Electric Vehicles, Solar Development, Sustainable Energy Solutions segments. The Electric Vehicles segment offers ruggedized electric vehicles and related products for use in off-road and ruggedized environments, including mining, infrastructure, utilities, government services, humanitarian, tourism and agriculture sectors.The Data Center segment engages in cryptocurrency mining and hosting operations. The Sustainable Energy Solutions segment is involved in the design, evaluation, sale, and implementation of renewable energy infrastructure. The Solar Development segment engages in solar development activities. The company was formerly known as VivoPower International PLC and changed its name to VivoPower PLC in March 2026. VivoPower PLC was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
ceo: Mr. Tser Fah Chin (Co-Founder, Executive Chairman & CEO)
